title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
description: Join a small team building retrieval-augmented generation features for a customer support product. You will build and evaluate RAG pipelines, work with embeddings and vector search, and ship FastAPI services that call large language models.

title: Backend Engineer Intern
description: Work on the REST API behind a logistics dashboard. You will write Django views and database migrations, optimise PostgreSQL queries, and add automated tests under the guidance of a senior engineer.

title: Frontend Engineer Intern
description: Build accessible user interface components in React and TypeScript for a design-collaboration tool. You will turn designs into reusable components and fix usability issues reported by users.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Analyse anonymised patient scheduling data to predict appointment no-shows. You will clean data with pandas, train classification models with scikit-learn, and present findings to clinical operations staff.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Own the path from trained model to production. You will package PyTorch models in Docker, build training and deployment pipelines, and monitor model quality in production.

title: Software Engineer, Search
description: Improve relevance for an enterprise search product. You will tune BM25 scoring, design ranking experiments, and operate Elasticsearch clusters serving millions of queries.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Design high-throughput payment services in Go. You will lead architecture reviews, run Kubernetes workloads, and mentor junior engineers on reliability practices.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
description: Build features end to end for a helpdesk product, from React screens to Node APIs backed by MongoDB. You will join code reviews and own small features from design to release.

title: LLM Application Engineer
description: Build LLM-powered assistants for enterprise customers. You will design retrieval pipelines, write prompts, and create evaluation suites that measure answer accuracy and faithfulness to source documents.

title: Data Engineer Intern
description: Help maintain data pipelines that load product analytics into a warehouse. You will write Airflow DAGs, tune Spark jobs, and add data quality checks.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Run the cloud infrastructure for a SaaS platform. You will manage AWS resources with Terraform, operate Kubernetes clusters, and improve CI/CD pipelines.

title: Mobile Developer Intern
description: Build screens for a consumer fitness app in Flutter. You will integrate Firebase authentication and storage and fix bugs reported from the app stores.

title: NLP Research Intern
description: Support applied research on text classification and summarisation. You will fine-tune transformer models in PyTorch, design evaluation benchmarks, and write up experiment results.

title: Recommendation Systems Engineer
description: Improve content recommendations for a video streaming service. You will train embedding-based recommenders, analyse results with SQL, and run A/B tests to measure engagement.

title: Backend Engineer, Payments
description: Build the deposit and withdrawal services for an online sports betting and gambling platform. You will write Django services and keep payment flows reliable at peak match times.

title: QA Automation Intern
description: Write automated browser and API tests for a web application. You will use Selenium and pytest, report defects clearly, and help keep the regression suite stable.

title: Junior Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor security alerts in a SIEM, triage incidents, and write Python scripts to automate repetitive investigation steps.

title: AI Product Intern
description: Work with product managers to prototype features powered by large language models. You will write prompts, analyse usage with SQL, and summarise findings for the team.

title: Backend Engineer (Python)
description: Build and maintain FastAPI services backed by PostgreSQL for an analytics product. You will write tests, containerise services with Docker, and participate in on-call rotations.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develop object detection models for factory inspection cameras. You will train PyTorch models, optimise inference in C++, and validate accuracy on production line data.

title: Software Engineering Intern, Platform
description: Contribute to internal platform services written in Java and Spring Boot. You will build Kafka consumers and improve service observability.

title: ML Platform Intern
description: Help build the internal platform that trains and serves machine learning models. You will containerise workloads, write deployment automation, and add monitoring dashboards.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Build weekly sales dashboards in Tableau, answer ad-hoc questions with SQL, and automate reporting with Python scripts.

title: Game Developer Intern
description: Prototype gameplay features in Unity and C#. You will build small mechanics, playtest them with the team, and fix bugs.
